title: Template:Infobox location/doc
content:
==Description== To use this template, copy the following code and fill in the appropriate fields. ==Syntax== 
{{infobox location
 | title         = 
 | image         = [e.g. "Example.jpg"]
 | imagewidth    = [e.g. "150"] [default: 210 pixels]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | map           = [e.g. "Example.jpg"]
 | mapwidth      = [e.g. "150"] [default: 210 pixels]
 | mapcaption    = 
 | type          = 
 | level         = 
 | location      = 
 | inhabitants   = 
}}
==Samples== 
{{infobox location
 | title         = Flora Island
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | imagecaption  = The island
 | map           = Example.jpg
 | mapcaption    = Zone map
 | type          = Contested
 | level         = 1-5
 | location      = Earth
 | inhabitants   = Stompy Humans, Drinky Bees
}}
Results in... {{infobox location | title = Flora Island | image = Example.jpg | imagecaption = The island | map = Example.jpg | mapcaption = Zone map | type = Contested | level = 1-5 | location = Earth | inhabitants = Stompy Humans, Drinky Bees }} [[Category:Infobox templates|{{PAGENAME}}]][[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]
